title: Two Color
description: Two color, in two color cinematography, is a duotone law: a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography. Two inks, no extras: teal-and-orange with a thousand leftovers is not this.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Posters, fables, a political still: assign the two hues to shadow and light, or to figure and ground, then kill everything else. Spot color can attach to a coat, a person, or a changing state of the world.
Naturalistic skin may break the law unless one hue is the skin. It is the wrong tool as a mild grade, and the wrong tool if random colors leak through motion.
The selection must stay stable. Complexity of extra inks is a leak, not richness.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Lock off, 35mm to 50mm. Plan wardrobe and walls so only two hues survive, then mask or grade the rest to the pair or to monochrome plus one.
Prompt: Two-color law on [Subject], a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography. Name the two hues.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: A poster, a fable, a political still, a coat that must be the only color. Do not use it as teal-orange blockbuster, and do not let extra hues leak.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Schindler's List keeps the red coat as a signal inside monochrome. Pleasantville lets color arrive as a change of state.
Sin City punctuates high-contrast monochrome with selected inks. Law, not a LUT.
Keep the selection stable.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Name the two hues and assign them. Two-color law on [Subject], a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography.
Add wardrobe planned for the split, lock-off, no leftover inks, stable through motion. Not teal-orange.

A crowded monochrome railway platform, with only one small yellow suitcase retaining its natural color. Track the suitcase as it changes hands; all other objects stay black and white. Stable object identity, clean edge tracking, no random patches of color.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: A teal-orange blockbuster, or random leaks. The tell is a thousand leftovers.
Fix it: two hues only, assigned, stable through occlusion.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Two Color in film?
A duotone or spot-color law: two hues do all the drawing, or one object keeps color in a monochrome world. Print as cinematography, not a mild grade.
Two Color vs Monochrome
Monochrome is one ink. Two color is a pair, or monochrome plus a chosen signal. If everything is grey, you wanted monochrome. If a coat stays red, you are in this family.
When should I use Two Color?
Posters, fables, political stills, a recurring color signal. Skip teal-orange leftovers and leaky masks.
How do I prompt Two Color for AI image or video?
Name the two hues, plan wardrobe, then: Two-color law on [Subject], a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography. Kill every other ink. Keep the rule stable in motion.
